basic_info.description: Carlos Santana, the legendary guitarist, grew up in the Mission and his musical roots can still be felt throughout the neighborhood --- alive with rhythm, culture, and creativity. This remarkable top-floor two-bedroom condominium feels like a place where you'll want to give it your heart and make it your home. Like a true work of art, it is uniquely designed to tickle your senses, with expert interior design and abundant natural light streaming through oversized windows in nearly every room. Set your sights on the pristine and expansive mural just outside the bedroom windows and imagine you've stepped into the painter's studio, consumed with inspiration and awe. The open floor plan and remodeled bathroom thoughtfully blend function with fashion. World-class restaurants, cafes, and Dolores Park are only moments away while pride of ownership bursts at the seams of this four-unit building meticulously managed by attentive and hospitable homeowners. Just imagine this is your home. Your life. And like Santana might say, Give it your heart, make it real . . you won't forget about it.
